name: Lunar Hatchling
oracle_text:
Flying, trample
Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)
Escape—{4}{G}{U}, Exile a land you control, Exile five other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.)
blocked_sentences: Escape—{4}{G}{U}, Exile a land you control, Exile five other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.)

needs.what: a cost key that exiles a permanent you control from the battlefield, chosen by selector as the cost is paid (here {"types": ["Land"]}), usable inside a card-level `graveyard_cost` so escape can charge "{4}{G}{U}, Exile a land you control, Exile five other cards from your graveyard" with `graveyard_cast: "graveyard"`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: graveyard_cost + graveyard_cast: graveyard already expresses escape's mana and exile_from_graveyard parts, but cost_keys has only exile_self (the source itself), exile_from_hand and exile_from_graveyard; sacrifice puts the land in the graveyard (where it could even feed the five-card exile) rather than exile, so it would be a different, cheaper card
